title: scutellaria hookeri
intro: Scutellaria hookeri, commonly known as Hooker's Skullcap, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hooker's Skullcap include its ability to calm anxiety and insomnia, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as baicalein and baicalin, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been shown to have neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties.
